sourceRefs.locator: Sections Huitzilopochco and Desarrollo del asentamiento. Southwestern lake shore, fresh and brackish water, chinampas and neighbouring allies; in 1428 Tenochtitlan imposed tribute in goods and labour.
Overview; Key Events, ca. 1427 and ca. 1431. Tenochtitlan’s alliance with Texcoco and Tlacopan, Azcapotzalco, indirect rule, tribute and Tlaxcala’s autonomy. Earlier enlargements of the main temple.
Q1002986, coordinate location (P625). General orientation at the named site.
